answer_dialog_crash.text: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'value')
answer_dialog_crash.trigger: Any input into the Answer textarea

insufficient_resources.trigger: Sustained polling — /status was requested 123x and /timeline 121x in ~10min; roughly 240 of the 250 last resource entries had transferSize=0 status=0. Chrome per-origin socket pool likely exhausted by SSE reconnect churn or double-mount effect.
insufficient_resources.suspect: Overly aggressive react-query refetch interval OR SSE stream not closed on route change OR StrictMode double-invocation still present in build

network_non_2xx.cause: API route /fleet wins over SPA fallback; a browser refresh/bookmark on any client-side route (Fleet/Timeline/Questions/Tasks/Cost) 401s instead of loading the SPA. Design coupling — see finding 4.

lab-emit CLI cannot find q-webqa-1-test-blocker in docs/lab/questions/queue.jsonl (only in the DB). SQLite is not the exclusive source of truth for the action layer today — the actions still shell out to lab-emit which reads JSONL. Not a defect in this run (scratch env limitation), but a real architectural note: DB-only rows cannot be deferred/applied.

findings.title: Answer dialog throws on first keystroke — owner cannot answer any BLOCKER/DECISION from the web
findings.root_cause: React 19 is free to invoke the state-updater function outside the synchronous handler window. By the time the updater reads `e.currentTarget.value`, the SyntheticEvent has been recycled and `e.currentTarget` is null → TypeError. React Router catches the throw and blanks the whole panel with 'Something went wrong'.
findings.fix: Read the string synchronously: `onChange={(e) => { const v = e.currentTarget.value; setAnswerDialog(prev => prev === null ? prev : { ...prev, value: v }); }}`
findings.impact: The Answer button is the primary owner action on the Questions screen. Once it crashes, the entire /questions route is a 'Something went wrong' page until the user reloads. Reproducible with the automation harness; likely intermittent under real typing, guaranteed to bite the moment React 19 runs the updater async.

findings.title: Chrome logs 5,087 ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES during a normal QA walkthrough
findings.where: Client polling / SSE lifecycle (route unmount cleanup)
findings.root_cause: Not proven from client alone. Symptoms: ~250 recent resource entries, 240+ with transferSize=0 status=0; only /status and /timeline polls are affected; SSE /events reconnect churn is the most likely driver on top of react-query polling. May compound with React StrictMode double-mount if not disabled in the built SPA.
findings.fix: Instrument react-query staleTime/refetchInterval and confirm SSE EventSource.close() runs on route unmount. If StrictMode is on in production build, disable it.
findings.impact: Any long-lived tab (owner leaves the panel open all day) will hit Chrome's per-origin socket ceiling and stop refreshing silently. On mobile Safari this class of error also surfaces as blank cards.
evidence: console.error count = 5087; recent /status 123x, /timeline 121x — see report section 'Console & network'

findings.title: Snapshot success has no visible toast
findings.root_cause: Notifications region stays empty after the successful snapshot (file was written to disk; server_intents row is 'ok'). Contrast: Permission Allow/Deny and Tick DO show toasts.
findings.fix: Emit the same shape of toast as the other actions on success.
findings.impact: The owner clicks Snapshot, dialog closes, nothing happens visibly. They may click again or wonder if it worked.

findings.title: Refreshing /fleet /timeline /questions /tasks /cost returns 401, not the SPA
findings.where: apps/core/src/serve.ts (SPA fallback mounted LAST, after every same-named API route)
findings.root_cause: The server-side /fleet /timeline /questions /tasks /cost routes are Bearer-gated API endpoints. A hard reload of any of those client-side URLs hits the API route first, gets 401 with body 'unauthorized', and the SPA never loads. Only /overview happens to not collide with an API name.
findings.fix: Either give SPA routes a namespace (e.g. /panel/*) or make the API routes an /api/* prefix, or detect 'Accept: text/html' in each API route and fall through to the SPA index.
findings.impact: Every browser bookmark and every refresh of a non-Overview page breaks the panel. The owner learns 'don't reload'. This is the kind of thing the phone dashboard tunnel makes worse.
evidence: reproducible via URL bar navigation to http://127.0.0.1:7333/fleet — body 'unauthorized'

findings.title: Cost screen has NO explanatory copy about the empty state or what would fill it
findings.root_cause: Screen renders 'No cost events recorded yet.' + one help line 'Aggregation table lands with the fleet dashboard task.' — but there is no hint how or when cost events will begin arriving (which producer, which endpoint). New readers may think it is broken.
findings.fix: One extra sentence naming the producer and the endpoint the panel is polling.

findings.title: Options JSON on Questions screen is rendered raw (pretty-printed JSON block) instead of as pickable choices
findings.where: Questions screen — each open question card
findings.root_cause: The OPTIONS field is dumped as literal `["light","dark","both"]`. The Answer dialog does not surface those choices as buttons either; it forces a free-form textbox even when the question has a clean short list.
findings.fix: When `options` is an array of ≤6 short strings/labels, render them as a radio group in the Answer dialog and pre-fill the answer on select.
findings.impact: Slower answers, higher chance of typos landing as the answer text.

punch_list: Fix Answer dialog textarea: read e.currentTarget.value synchronously before setState (finding #1). Blocks primary owner flow.
Investigate ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES 5,087x — instrument react-query refetch and confirm SSE close-on-unmount (finding #2). Long-lived tabs will silently stall.
Route ordering: hard reload of /fleet /timeline /questions /tasks /cost returns 401 (finding #4). Introduce /panel or /api prefix so the SPA fallback wins for browser navigations.
Surface a toast for the Snapshot success (finding #3). Silent success reads as broken.
Surface a toast for /actions/questions/defer failure (currently silent — evidence in run 26).
Options-as-buttons in Answer dialog when the question has ≤6 short options (finding #6). Removes typos and speeds answering.
